text: في الدقيقة 65، قررت Redmond Rovers اللعب بضغط أعلى وخط دفاعي مرتفع، مع لعب مباشر أكثر عشان تكسر دفاع Ironvale Athletic الصلب[#1190]. بالرغم من إن الاستحواذ نزل من 63% لـ 45%، لكنهم ركزوا اللعب في نصف ملعب الخصم بنسبة 79%، وده زود فرصهم للتسجيل حسب التوقعات للأهداف من 0.22 لـ 0.87، يعني فرصهم جات بشكل أفضل بعد التغيير[#1190]. الآن اللعب أصبح أسرع وأقرب على المرمى، وده بيخلي الفرصة قدامهم علشان يرجعوا في النتيجة.

- At 65', Redmond Rovers' coach Ilse Marchetti opted to chase the game by increasing pressing intensity, raising their defensive line, and playing more direct to break down Ironvale Athletic's low block and deep defensive setup [#1190].
- This tactical shift saw Redmond's press increase from 0.82 to 1.0 and directness rise from 0.48 to 0.63, reflecting a move away from their usual quick circulation and high defensive line towards more aggressive ball recovery in advanced areas [#1190].
- Although possession dropped from 63.1% to 45.8%, Redmond increased their field tilt from 57.8% to 78.9%, indicating they concentrated play more in the opponent's half, consistent with a pressing trap and overload pattern to force turnovers and create chances in Ironvale’s penalty area [#1190].
- Ironvale’s 5-3-2 low block and counter-attacking style was challenged by Redmond’s higher press and direct approach, resulting in more box touches (rising from 5 to 12) and an increased expected goals (xG) value (from 0.22 to 0.87), demonstrating Redmond’s tactical intent to disrupt Ironvale’s shape and exploit spaces behind their deep defensive line [#1190].
